content.description: The conversational response, explanations, reasoning, and standard chat text. Use Markdown.

cell_id.description: The exact identifier for the target cell (e.g., 'func:my_func'). Required for CELL_PATCH.

code_content.description: The source code. For CELL_PATCH/CREATE, the FIRST line MUST be the marker: '# %% [<cell_id>]'. Provide FULL logic; never redact for brevity.

artifacts.description: A list of new files to be created. Use this for proposing entirely new artifacts that do not currently exist.

filename.description: The target filename for the new artifact (e.g., 'new_utils.py'). This path should be relative to the project root.

code_content.description: The full source code for the new file.

description.description: A very brief 3-5 word label for this new file.

changelog.description: BLOCKING GATE: every patch response MUST include at least one entry. Classify the work strictly using `change_type`. `summary` is affirmative documentation of the final state — not a recount of past conversational errors. `cellsmith patch` rejects payloads with a missing or malformed changelog and appends accepted entries to CHANGELOG.cellsmith.jsonl at the target root.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp. If omitted, `cellsmith patch` fills it with the apply-time timestamp.

summary.description: Concise single-sentence overview of the final state achieved.

details.description: Granular bulleted technical modifications or impacted fields.

task_update.description: An optional update to the task manager state. Only use when in tasking mode.

memory_content.description: A concise summary of the work done for the current step.

mark_step_complete.description: Set to true if the current step is fully completed and the plan should advance.
